subject: Re: AWS Marketplace listing — copy QC, co-sell roles, and field handoff
body:
From: Jared Collins <jared@acme-analytics.com>
To: Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.inference>
Cc: procurement@acme-analytics.com
Date: Tue, 27 Mar 2028 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: AWS listing copy finalization + co-sell roles

Hi Mateo —

Thanks again for the demo last week. We need to get the AWS Marketplace listing submitted this quarter and wanted your help aligning copy and the co-sell motion (who owns field outreach, sample decks, and marketplace CTA behavior).

Quick asks:
- Can you review the one-pager and marketplace blurb attached and flag anything that will block approval in AWS?
- We also need to understand what co-sell assets Redwood will provide vs. what we should own.
- Prefer a short checklist/setup so our GTM ops can finish the submission.

Attached: aws_marketplace_blurb_v1.docx

Appreciate a quick turnaround — legal review starts next Monday.

—Jared

---

From: Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.inference>
To: Jared Collins <jared@acme-analytics.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.inference>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.inference>
Date: Wed, 28 Mar 2028 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: AWS listing copy finalization + co-sell roles

Jared — thanks for the deck and the blurb. Quick read-through below and I added a short onboarding plan.

Top-line feedback on copy (high priority):
- Avoid absolute claims ("100% accurate"); AWS flags strong guarantees. Suggest: "industry-leading accuracy for common customer intents".
- Replace internal product names in the hero with a short benefit-first line: what customers get in the first 30 days.
- Pricing blurb: call out trial terms (30-day free trial) and link to the private offer flow if you need entitlements.

Co-sell & field handoff (proposed split):
- Redwood provides: marketplace listing copy, a co-sell slide kit (we will draft the first pass), SKU/AMI technical metadata for the listing, and a short FAQ to include in the listing.
- Acme provides: customer references, procurement contact for private offers, and field playbook localized to your reps.
- Joint items: demo recording for the listing page, a one-page ROI example that both teams can use in outreach.

Action plan / checklist for next 7 days:
1) We will pull a redline of your blurb and return v2 (by EOD Thurs).
2) Kimberly will sanity-check legal-sensitive phrasing and the evidence language.
3) Marissa will start the co-sell slide kit template and share a draft link.
4) You share any preferred customer logos and the procurement contact for privateoffer setup.

I attached a redlined doc (redlined_aws_listing_v2.docx) and a starter co-sell playbook PDF.

—Mateo

Attachments: redlined_aws_listing_v2.docx, co-sell_playbook_acme.pdf

---

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.inference>
To: Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.inference>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.inference>
Date: Thu, 29 Mar 2028 08:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: AWS listing copy finalization + co-sell roles

Forwarding my suggested legal/claims edits. I focused on three areas: evidence language (what qualifies as proof), pricing footnotes, and the trial/private-offer wording that tends to trip up Marketplace QA.

Key redlines I added (summary):
- Evidence: change "customers report 50% faster" -> "in customer pilots, teams observed up to 50% faster..." and include a required citation line.
- Pricing footnote: add a short sentence on metering behavior for private offers (how trial entitlements map to AMI usage).
- CTA language: avoid "buy now" as a hard term; use "Start free trial" or "Request private offer" depending on SKU.

Kimberly's file notes: see redlined_aws_listing_v2.docx (track changes).

Please confirm if we want Redwood to own the first outreach email for co-sell or have Acme send the initial seller-intro. My recommendation: Redwood sends the seller-intro (email + short deck), Acme follows with customer references and procurement details.

—Kimberly

---

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.inference>
To: Jared Collins <jared@acme-analytics.com>, Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.inference>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.inference>
Date: Fri, 30 Mar 2028 14:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: AWS listing copy finalization + co-sell roles

Thanks all — Jared, quick updates and next steps from our side: 

What Redwood will deliver by Mon (Apr 2):
- Final marketplace blurb v2 (copy + 1-line evidence footnote) — attached.
- Co-sell slide kit (editable Google Slides link) and a 2-email outreach sequence for AWS field sellers.
- A short onboarding checklist for your GTM ops with the AMI/SKU naming conventions and tagging requirements.

What we need from Acme by Mon (Apr 2):
- 2 customer logos + 1-line use case each (for listing).
- Procurement contact to set up private offer (email + phone).
- Any pricing footnotes you require for the trial.

I'll schedule a 30-min sync next Tue to run through the slide kit and the private-offer steps. Mateo — can you confirm you'll send the final copy by EOD Mon? Kimberly — can you confirm legal is OK with the revised evidence wording?

Next steps: Jared, can you share the logos to this thread and upload the final procurement contact to the Drive folder linked below? Once procurement confirms, we can open the private-offer flow on the AWS portal and loop in the AWS partner team for co-sell enablement.

Cheers,

—Marissa Cole
Senior Partnerships Manager | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.inference
Attachments: marketplace_blurb_v2.docx
